title: Print Float in Scientific Notation

content.problemStatement: Accept a float value as input and print the same in Exponential Form

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '1234.567' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Accept a float value and print it in scientific exponential notation with 6 decimals and 2-digit exponent.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Print using %e format specifier, which formats numbers like 1.234567e+03.

hints: Scientific notation uses '%e' in C/Java printf.
In Python, f'{val:e}' formats scientific notation.
In JavaScript, pad the exponent digits if needed.
learningObjectives: Represent very large and very small floating point numbers.
